name: PortEden Email
examples_zh: 在我的 Gmail 和 Outlook 账户中搜索过去 7 天来自客户域名的邮件，按待回复、已安排会议和仅需归档分类。
读取 Exchange 收件箱里带有合同附件的邮件，汇总发件人、主题、日期和附件名称，不执行删除或转发操作。
帮我整理今天的未读邮件优先级，标出需要我确认后才能回复或转发的邮件草稿建议。
examples_en: Search my Gmail and Outlook accounts for messages from the customer domain in the last seven days and group them into reply-needed, meeting-scheduled, and archive-only.
Read Exchange inbox messages that include contract attachments and summarize sender, subject, date, and attachment names without deleting or forwarding anything.
Prioritize today's unread email and mark which messages would need my confirmation before any reply or forward is sent.
description_zh: 安全邮件管理，支持 Gmail/Outlook/Exchange 多账户收发、搜索与分类
description_en: Secure email management for Gmail, Outlook & Exchange with multi-account read, send, search & triage
